summary: Grayscale Sui Staking ETF filed an 8-K on September 29, 2026 disclosing a Sixth Amendment to its Master Custody Service Agreement with Anchorage Digital Bank N.A., a national trust bank. The Trust thereby becomes a party, adding Anchorage as an additional custodian for a portion of its SUI holdings; Coinbase Custody remains primary custodian and existing arrangements are unaffected. The Sponsor has not yet determined how much SUI will migrate. Anchorage will withdraw SUI for Sponsor's Fees and Additional Trust Expenses upon instruction; fees are Sponsor-paid. No price, stake, premium, or deal terms are stated; routine custody contract, not a special situation.
